newsitem.title: USA: COOLER WEATHER NOT DAMAGING FOR BRAZIL COFFEE- WSC.
newsitem.headline: COOLER WEATHER NOT DAMAGING FOR BRAZIL COFFEE- WSC.

text.p: Cool, high pressure currently in Argentina now appears large enough to produce a "glancing blow of cooler weather" to Brazil's coffee belt, however no damaging cold is expected, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Thursday.
"As the high moves off the coast it will tend to build northward during the first half of next week keeping the coffee belt cool and dry, " WSC said.
Fair to partly cloudy skies were reported in main growing areas of the belt this morning. Temperatures ranged from 54-63 F (12-17 C).

Fair to partly cloudy skies with the chance of a few light showers are expected through Sunday. Low temperatures could fall to the middle 40's to low 50's F (7-11 C) over the weekend. Some cooler conditions may hit higher elevations.

Cool, dry conditions are forecast for next week. Lows should be in the middle 40's to middle 50's F (7-13 C). There is still no damaging cold weather expected, according to WSC. ((Eileen Houlihan, New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
